name: FedEx Freight Hub - Harrison AR (HRO)
type: Freight LTL hub / former American Freightways HQ campus

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '2200 Forward Dr, Harrison AR' and coordinates (36.256793, -93.132174, GEOMETRIC_CENTER) resolve to the correct campus. This is the FedEx Freight HRO service center co-located with FedEx Freight Corporate Offices on the heritage American Freightways HQ campus. Confirmed by satellite (corporate office complex + two LTL cross-dock buildings + large employee parking) and Street View (2024) showing FedEx-branded trailers in the operations yard and perimeter fencing.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has distinct building clusters: a connected corporate-office complex on the east side plus two separate long LTL cross-dock terminal buildings on the west side, with internal roads and ponds between them.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire campus is perimeter-fenced (chain-link around the operations/parking sides, decorative metal fence on the corporate frontage). The operating LTL terminal yard is access-controlled as a FedEx Freight network standard. The corporate-office driveway off Forward Dr is open-access employee parking; the truck entrance to the dock yard is a separate controlled point. Exact gate not directly Street-View confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth identified in satellite or Street View at the truck entrance. Classified as remote/kiosk check-in (remoteGs true). Low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two long narrow LTL cross-dock buildings each with a regular rhythm of dock doors on both long faces and trailers backed in; combined estimate ~90 doors, placing the site in the 50+ band. Door count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Paved trailer parking around both dock buildings holds dozens of trailers/pups without tractors; estimated 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated paved trailer-storage areas flank the two cross-dock buildings.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large internal paved yard between the dock buildings and the office complex gives ample room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Harrison AR is a small town (~13,000 population) in the Ozarks; the campus sits on the edge of town surrounded by fields and low-density development. Classified Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two LTL cross-dock buildings + a connected corporate-office complex counted as ~3 office structures = 5 distinct buildings.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the campus; classified false.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved yard could serve as a post-gate holding area; inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box; includes corporate offices, large employee parking, ponds, and lawns in addition to the truck-operations area.
